instantiate_stylegan: create a StyleGAN instance with custom nMappings, phiTruncation, and gamma_avg hyperparameters
get_generator_network: build the StyleGAN generator network by calling getNetG to construct a GNet with mapping layers
add_resolution_scale: add a new resolution scale to the progressive StyleGAN model using the addScale method
update_blending_alpha: update the progressive blending factor alpha to control resolution transition during training
configure_truncation_trick: configure the StyleGAN truncation trick by setting phiTruncation to control sample diversity
